title: Cat Hub [ 60+ Functions ]
features:
CatHub — Universal Script | Millenium GUI

After loading the script, go to the "configs" section and select the desired key for closing it; by default, there is no key assigned to open or close it.

in my discord giveaways for lifetime key!

🎯 AIMBOT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Aimbot with smooth camera tracking
• Silent Aim — snaps without moving camera

• Visible Check — only target players you can see

• Team Check — ignore teammates

• Smoothness slider (1–50)

• Aim Bone — Head / Neck / UpperTorso / HRP
• Priority — Crosshair / LowestHP / Nearest
• FOV Circle with color and thickness options

• Health Bar — Left / Right / Bottom, gradient color (green→yellow→red)
• Player Name + Distance — separate toggles
• Tracers — from bottom / center / top of screen
• Head Dot — filled circle on head
